name: Asahi Co., Ltd.
summary: Asahi Co., Ltd. sells bicycles, parts, accessories, and other related products. It also offers ancillary services, such as maintenance and repair. The company owns approximately 450 stores as a large chain specialty store √Ç¬ëCycle Base Asahi' in Japan. It also operates three online stores at its Networking Store, Cycle Mall Yahoo, and Cycle Mall Rakuten Ichiba. The company was formerly known as Asahi Gangu and changed its name to Asahi Co., Ltd. in May 1992. Asahi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
